title: Safe Welfare Regret with Delayed Costs in a Two-Stratum Randomized Benchmark
banked_reason: Sound fixed benchmark below the field floor; reviewer letter-tier novelty rejection and two structurally defeated field-level pivots, confirmed STOP by independent validity gate.
gap_reasons: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: the fixed two-stratum known-cost benchmark seeks an exact constant from inherited Gaussian and calibration ingredients, without a wider law class, new causal estimand, strict named-comparator improvement, or transferable statistical frontier.
Pivot to a generic delayed-cost PAC-safety frontier or a strict comparator theorem; the present fixed benchmark is not realistically repairable to the required field tier by a local revision.
With known costs and a public center, its exactly feasible oracle provides a fallback with normalized compact-local regret at most 2H.

Consequently, feasible vertices or lotteries over inward-calibrated vertices dominate safe interior policies up to o(m^-1/2); varying finite-support cost laws or adding strata does not produce the required complementary interior advantage.
proof_attempt_summary: The fixed four-cell delayed-cost PAC-safety benchmark was judged sound but incremental/letter-tier against the operator field floor. Two non-identical field-level pivots failed: fallback mixing removed the proposed unavoidable calibration loss, and convex first-order deployment geometry ruled out the demanded interior-policy advantage. The independent validity gate confirmed downgrade and stop; discovery never reached D0 or Lean formalization, and the retained benchmark is not a certified theorem.
tldr: Delayed utilization prevents a planner from stopping treatment when the budget is exhausted. In a specified known-cost two-stratum randomized benchmark, four unknown Bernoulli outcome means determine welfare while a known finite-cohort tail determines deployment feasibility. The target is the sharp exhausted-local positive-part welfare regret under an exactly uniform probability cap on selecting an infeasible policy. The full-cell information, unrestricted policy comparison, and original-data probability certificate isolate the missing lift from a known Gaussian abstention calculation. The value and attaining construction remain answer-open; the contribution is an incremental calibrated benchmark and an information correction.
gap: Kalashnov, Munro, Sun, Du and Wager distinguish delayed costs from immediate budget stopping. Huang, Hou and Tan already settle the scalar Gaussian abstention ingredient. Neither inspected result supplies an exact globally safe full-cell delayed-cohort lift with an unrestricted converse and compact-local original-data attainment.
fill: Full four-cell information replaces restricted-path arithmetic. A uniform safe-action lottery comparison and a bounded mirror-likelihood bound support the converse. Studentization and certified full-box event polynomials provide the construction handle. The common value, its deployment-parameter dependence, and the original-data regret discrepancy are derived rather than preset.
